success_criteria: Frozen weights match their hash; no refitting or threshold selection
No exact prestate or group overlap with any development partition
Successor retrieval lift over group chance has a strictly positive lower 95 percent group-bootstrap bound
Correct-action weighted MSE beats the paired alternate with a strictly negative upper 95 percent group-bootstrap bound
failure_handling: Report every failed criterion without filtering target failures or revising this candidate after evaluation.
limitations: Two fixed UI navigation alternatives only. Earlier failed dark-screen data influenced the choice to train mixed themes but was not used for fitting. This protocol uses another reserved viewport and fresh capture seed; it cannot establish arbitrary desktop success, safety or Jev parity.
